OH, HEY! I’M CHAVI.

A soft spot for cute.
A big love for
good design.

I’m the human behind Chavi Designs. I make brand identities, packaging and all the little things that turn a business into a world people want to step into.

I love stories with personality — in a brand, in a café, or in a K-drama I definitely meant to watch just one episode of. That curiosity finds its way into everything I make.

Bring your idea. I’ll bring the colour palettes, the thoughtful details and a very enthusiastic “what if…”
